notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
The creature dies, triggering Weatherlight Compleated, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
